title: $T_{E,\Qlb}$ preserves bounded constructible complexes
statement:
For a prime $\ell$, a scheme $X$, a finite extension $E$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Qlb$ and a
bounded constructible complex $K$ of $E_X$-modules ([sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]), the
complex $T_{E,\Qlb}K$ ([def-sfb-derived-extend-to-qlbar]) is a bounded constructible complex of
$\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$-modules.

proof.text: Put $R=E_X$, $B=\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$ and $A=\operatorname{Ext}_{R\to B}$. By [lem-sfb-qlbar-flat] and [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars], $A$ preserves finite limits and finite colimits, hence is exact. By [def-sfb-left-derived-exact], the functor $T_{E,\Qlb}$ of [def-sfb-derived-extend-to-qlbar] is its termwise derived functor. Apply [lem-sfb-extend-scalars-preserves-homology] (flatness holds on every scheme) to obtain $H^n(T_{E,\Qlb}K)\cong A(H^n(K))$ for every $n$.

source.place: First clause: exact extension, termwise computation and homology

proof.text: Fix $n$ and set $M=H^n(K)$. The definitions [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], [def-sfb-constructible-module] and [def-sfb-locally-finitely-presented] supply a finite stratification $g_a\colon X_a\to X$ and, on each stratum, a pro-étale presentation cover $u\colon V\to X_a$. Apply [lem-sfb-internal-extension-inverse-image] first to $g_a$ and then to $u$. The restriction of $A(M)$ on this cover is thereby the scalar extension of the finitely presented restriction of $M$, along the actual ring map $u^{-1}g_a^{-1}(R\to B)$. By [lem-sfb-internal-extension-finite-presentation] it is finitely presented. Thus the same covers and strata witness constructibility of $A(M)$. Isomorphism invariance here follows by composing the isomorphism in each cokernel presentation with the restricted comparison isomorphism.

source.place: Last clause: presentations on the same strata and covers, using actual inverse-image coefficient rings

proof.text: Choose the finite cohomology interval $[a,b]$ of $K$ from [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]. Outside it, step 1 identifies the new cohomology with $A(0)=0$; $A$ preserves zero since it preserves finite colimits by [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]. Inside it, steps 1 and 2 give constructible cohomology, with presentation witnesses transported through their isomorphisms. The criterion [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible] proves the conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Original exactness and local-presentation route, with the two internal-module calculations extracted
